Welcome to Madginford Primary School
We are a vibrant and nurturing community where children are encouraged to be confident, curious and ambitious learners. We believe every child deserves an education that inspires a love of learning and helps them grow into capable, compassionate and responsible individuals.
Children only have one chance at their primary education, and we are passionate about making their time with us truly special. Through inspiring teaching, memorable experiences and high expectations, we place every child’s learning and wellbeing at the heart of all that we do.
Madginford is a forward-thinking, values-led school. Our values guide our pupils to respect others, care for the world around them and strive for excellence in everything they do.
We work closely with parents and the wider community to ensure every child thrives and achieves their very best.
Visitors are always warmly welcomed, and I look forward to meeting you

Children with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND)
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Madginford Primary School, we believe that every child belongs. We are committed to creating an inclusive, nurturing and ambitious environment where all children are valued, respected and supported to achieve their very best.
We recognise that every child is unique, with their own strengths, interests and individual needs. Our approach focuses on removing barriers to learning, ensuring that all pupils have access to a broad and ambitious curriculum and the opportunity to achieve academically, socially and personally.
Our SEND Team
Our SEND Coordinator is:
Mrs S. Farrell – SENDCo
Mrs Farrell works closely with our Heads of School, Miss Allen (EYFS and Key Stage 1) and Miss Stamp (Key Stage 2), to ensure that inclusion remains at the heart of school life and that every child receives the right support at the right time.
Our SEND team works collaboratively with teachers, support staff, children and families to understand individual needs and provide effective support. We believe that strong relationships, early identification and a detailed understanding of each child are essential in helping pupils feel confident, included and ready to learn.
The SEND team supports staff to identify needs, plan effective strategies and monitor progress carefully. They work closely with specialist professionals and external agencies to access advice, guidance and expertise, ensuring that support is informed by the most appropriate approaches for each child.
We are committed to developing staff confidence and expertise through ongoing training, coaching and collaboration with specialists. This ensures that teachers and support staff have the knowledge, skills and resources needed to adapt learning, implement effective strategies and provide high-quality support for all pupils.
We carefully consider the resources and provision required to meet individual needs, ensuring that children have access to appropriate tools, interventions and adjustments that enable them to participate fully in school life.
Supporting Wellbeing and Inclusion
At Madginford, we know that children learn best when they feel safe, happy and a valued part of the school community.
We place children’s wellbeing at the centre of our approach, supporting their emotional, social and academic development. Through nurturing relationships, inclusive practice and appropriate support, we help children develop confidence, independence and resilience.
Every child is encouraged to participate fully, contribute to school life and experience success. We celebrate differences and ensure that all pupils know they are valued members of our school community.
The Inclusion Base
We are very proud of our Inclusion Base, which provides a calm, nurturing and supportive environment designed to help children develop the skills they need to thrive in school.
The Inclusion Base focuses on supporting children with social, emotional and mental health (SEMH) needs and speech, language and communication needs, which are key areas of need within our school community.
Through targeted support and carefully planned interventions, children are supported to develop confidence, communication skills, emotional regulation and positive relationships. The Inclusion Base complements classroom learning and helps children develop the skills they need to participate successfully in all aspects of school life.
The Inclusion Base provides a supportive start to the school day for identified children, helping them to transition successfully into learning. This may include opportunities to develop routines, build emotional readiness, practise communication skills and prepare positively for classroom engagement.
Throughout the day, children may access personalised support and interventions that help them to develop:
Provision within the Inclusion Base is carefully planned, monitored and reviewed to ensure that support is purposeful, effective and focused on helping children make progress.
We work closely with children, families, staff and external professionals to ensure that every child receives the right support at the right time and is able to belong, grow, achieve and thrive.
Emotional regulation and resilience.
Social communication and interaction skills.
Vocabulary, language and communication.
Confidence, independence and positive relationships.
Strategies to support engagement and learning.
Working Together with Families
We believe that strong partnerships between school and families are essential in supporting children to thrive.
If you have a concern about your child, please speak initially with their class teacher. They will work with the SEND team to understand your child’s needs, identify appropriate strategies and agree the best way forward.
Where further support is required, Mrs Farrell and the SEND team will work closely with families and relevant professionals to plan next steps and ensure children receive the support they need to succeed.
Contact Us
SENDCo – Mrs S. Farrell
Main School Office office@mps.kent.sch.uk

01. Welcome to SEND at Madginford
Supporting Every Child to Learn, Thrive and Flourish
At Madginford Primary School, we believe that every child is unique and deserves to feel valued, understood and supported.
Our approach to SEND is built around our school values. We believe that by living these values every day, we create an inclusive community where all children can develop confidence, independence and a strong sense of belonging.
Our values guide how we support children with SEND, helping every child to overcome barriers, celebrate their strengths and achieve their potential.
Our Values in Action
Respect
We listen to children and families, value everyone’s individual strengths and ensure that every child is treated with kindness, dignity and understanding.
We recognise that every child communicates, learns and experiences the world differently.
Curiosity
We encourage children to explore, ask questions and discover how they learn best.
We help children understand their own strengths, develop self-awareness and become confident learners.
Challenge
We have high aspirations for every child.
We support children to overcome barriers, try new things and believe in their ability to make progress and succeed.
Equality
We are committed to ensuring every child has access to the opportunities, experiences and support they need.
Equality does not mean every child receives the same support; it means every child receives the support that enables them to flourish.
Independence
We help children develop confidence, self-advocacy and the skills they need to become increasingly independent.
Through approaches such as This Is Me profiles and Pupil Passports, children are encouraged to understand their own strengths, needs and learning preferences.
Perseverance
We recognise that learning can sometimes feel challenging.
We support children to develop resilience, learn from mistakes and understand that progress happens through effort, encouragement and the right support.
Working Together
Strong partnerships between children, families, staff and professionals are at the heart of effective SEND support.
By working together, we can understand children better, remove barriers and help every child achieve their goals.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Madginford Primary School, we believe that every child should feel known, valued and supported.
Our SEND provision reflects our belief that all children can achieve when they are provided with the right opportunities, relationships and support.
Together, we help children develop the confidence, skills and independence to succeed both now and in the future.
Every child. Every opportunity. Every success.

Our Curriculum Big Picture
Curriculum Intent
CURIOUS – CHALLENGE – CONNECTIVITY
We have designed a curriculum that enables children to be challenged, to be curious and to make connections across all areas of learning so that learning is deep and secure.
We want our children…
Our ABC of curriculum design:
Ambitious
Our bespoke curriculum has been designed to ensure children have plenty of opportunities to develop the specific subject knowledge they need to build, consolidate and extend their learning as well as the powerful personal knowledge that gives them the dispositions, attitudes and habits they need to navigate their way through life.
Broad and Deep
Our curriculum is planned in such a way that content broadens and deepens learning but is not too wide or too shallow.
Carefully Considered
Our curriculum is carefully designed to ensure that learning is connected and sequenced exceptionally well between subjects.
Careful timetabling and revisiting of knowledge, skills and concepts ensures that learning is embedded and opportunities to secure understanding are maximised.
